description: This file contains a function implementation for processing data in chunks using SHA1 hashing, specifically the function git_SHA1_Update_Chunked which updates the SHA1 context with variable-sized data chunks, handling large data by processing in segments.

methods.name: int git_SHA1_Update_Chunked(platform_SHA_CTX * c,const void * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Updates a SHA1 context with data split into chunks, handling data in segments up to SHA1_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE.
